sections.text:
-Target: 1 random enemy out of all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 10x physical damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Heals 10% of max HP every 5 seconds for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (1 time).
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (2 times).
-Target: all allies. Applies dual attack, reducing the cooldown time of the next Ability used to 0 (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Boosts HP recovery effects by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
